summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of USD 300 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes issued under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme, listed on India International Exchange and NSE IFSC. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. The notes are rated BBB and Baa3, and not offered in the U.S. The filing is an ordinary current report with no strategic implications.
